R0984.condition: every traded-off output validated with an error statistic
R0984.reason: The crop-loss estimates (20% and 15%) are set beside the measured losses (26% and 22%) and called similar, with no error statistic, and the crop response curves were fitted to the same field data; only the light and PV outputs were compared with measurements using an error statistic, so not every traded-off output is validated with an error statistic.

R1200.condition: every traded-off output validated with an error statistic
R1200.reason: The PV-output prediction is independent of the measured data, but soiling is not modeled: the soiling loss is inferred afterwards from the gap between predicted and measured output, and the authors state that this estimate still needs comparison with future measurements.
